glosses: to scratch off, to scrape off (to remove from a surface, rubbing or scratching with a sharp object)

examples.text: Maciuś padając na ziemię zdrapał sobie skórę na ręce: pierwsza w tej wojnie odniesiona rana.
examples.translation: As Maciuś fell to the ground, he scratched off the skin on his hand: his first wound in this war.
examples.english: As Maciuś fell to the ground, he scratched off the skin on his hand: his first wound in this war.
